text: 1.The Applicant should be expected to study hard, observe the laws and decrees of the Chinese government and abide by the regulations of BUAA. 2.He/she must have a master's degree or have the equivalent educational background of a master's degree. 3.In general, the applicant should be forty-five years of age or under. 4.He/she must pass the entrance examination organized by the university. 5.He/she must be proficient in English and able to take courses in English or in Chinese.
